// CASE dart_chunk_canonical expect=pass
Future<void> mapWithConcurrency<T>(List<T> items, int width, Future<void> Function(T) operation) async {
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    await Future.wait(group.map(operation));
  }
}
// CASE dart_chunk_spread expect=pass
Future<void> mapWithConcurrency<T>(List<T> items, int width, Future<void> Function(T) operation) async {
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    sink.addAll([...await Future.wait(group.map(operation))]);
  }
}
// CASE dart_chunk_wrapped expect=pass
Future<void> mapWithConcurrency<T>(List<T> items, int width, Future<void> Function(T) operation) async {
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    sink.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
}
// CASE dart_inorder_spread expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    log([...await step(item)]);
  }
}
// CASE dart_inorder_wrapped expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    log(await step(item));
  }
}
